run_generate_object_pixel_counts: run the script to generate per-object pixel counts across frames for ScanNet scenes
build_scene_object_frame_map: build a mapping from scene IDs to object IDs and their frame indices with pixel counts
get_2d_labels: get 2D semantic labels for RGB coordinates by backprojecting and matching to 3D mask3d points
load_mask3d_scenes: load mask3d processed scene data from YAML database files for train and validation splits
save_frame_filenames_map: save a mapping of scene IDs to sorted color frame filenames for reference dataset
